Iron Elden Ring Pixel Particle Library
======================================

Source : https://github.com/shuimo0413/Iron-Elden-Ring-Particle-library
Author : shuimo0413
License: MIT -- Copyright (c) 2026 shuimo0413

Bundled content: 179 hand-drawn 32x32 particle sprites, taken verbatim from the upstream `particle/` directory.
They ship in this repository under, for each of the four platform lines
(neoforge-1.21.1, forge-1.20.1, fabric-1.20.1, neoforge-26.1.2):

    <line>/src/main/resources/assets/astral_dice/textures/particle/ier/*.png

and are enumerated by the generated list `assets/astral_dice/particles/particle_library.json`
(regenerate with `python tools/gen_particle_library.py`). In game they are exposed as the particle type
`astral_dice:particle_library`.

The upstream license text is reproduced verbatim below.
